proof_body:
by
  intro p _ a ha
  have hP := (Fact.out : p.Prime)
  let F : Polynomial (PadicInt p) := Polynomial.X ^ (p - 1) - 1
  have hF : ∀ z, Polynomial.eval z F = z ^ (p - 1) - 1 := by intro z; simp [F]
  have hF' : Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative F) = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : PadicInt p) * a ^ (p - 2) := by
    simp [F, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow]
    exact Or.inl (by rw [Nat.sub_sub])
  have h0 : ‖a ^ (p - 1) - 1‖ < 1 := by
    have hu : PadicInt.toZMod a ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hm : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicInt p) := by
        rw [← PadicInt.ker_toZMod]; exact h
      have := (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).1 hm
      exact this (PadicInt.isUnit_iff.2 ha)
    have h1 : PadicInt.toZMod (a ^ (p - 1) - 1) = 0 := by
      simp [ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hu]
    have hm : a ^ (p - 1) - 1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicInt p) := by
      rw [← PadicInt.ker_toZMod]; exact h1
    exact PadicInt.not_isUnit_iff.1 ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 hm)
  have h1 : ‖((p - 1 : ℕ) : PadicInt p) * a ^ (p - 2)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, ha, one_pow, mul_one, PadicInt.norm_natCast_p_sub_one]
  have hl : ‖Polynomial.aeval a F‖ < ‖Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, hF', h1]; simpa using h0
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hd, _, hu⟩ := hensels_lemma hl
  simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, hF', h1] at hz hd hu
  refine ⟨z, ⟨sub_eq_zero.1 hz, hd⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro w ⟨hw, hwa⟩
  exact hu w (by simp [hw]) hwa
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : PadicInt p), ‖a‖ = 1 → ∃! z : PadicInt p, z ^ (p - 1) = 1 ∧ ‖z - a‖ < 1
